selected_option: Preserve the receipt identity and unaffected execution metadata while redacting only the accidentally captured private fixture text.
rationale: Receipt receipt_01KZMM3FY75Z9440KG56GAKGWX captured a private fixture identifier in its diagnostic preview. The current-tree privacy migration retains its ID, status, timestamps, digests, and all unrelated fields; this decision records provenance without repeating the removed text.

Delete the affected receipt instead of preserving its non-sensitive evidence.

title: Constrain sticky creation boundaries
selected_option: Allow sticky shared-writable boundaries only when owned by the current user or root
rationale: POSIX sticky protection prevents other writers from renaming a newly owned entry, but the directory owner retains rename authority; trusting only the current user or root preserves conventional temporary-directory use without accepting an untrusted owner.

title: Preserve relative vault paths
selected_option: Keep relative --home and JIG_VAULT_HOME paths working-directory-relative
rationale: The CLI and runtime already accept relative PathBuf values, generated launcher behavior gives them a stable repository-root base, and rejecting them would be an unnecessary contract-v4 compatibility break.

title: Preserve only resolvable parent traversal
selected_option: Allow parent traversal when its prefix exists and reject traversal through a missing component before mutation
rationale: Linux resolves pathname components in order and returns ENOENT when a nonfinal component is missing; this keeps compatible leading ../ paths without creating a directory merely to traverse back out of it.

title: Retain verified restore parents after failure
selected_option: Keep verified empty parent directories and leave the selected vault home absent
rationale: The directories are normal owner-only vault infrastructure, retry remains safe, and automatic rollback could race another process that began using the prepared chain after preflight.
alternatives: Roll back all directories created by the attempt
